full_prompt_en: A square street-art photograph records a large mural of a small child seated on a deep windowsill. The child wears a pointed rust-red hood and matching close-fitting clothes, with knees pulled up and chin resting on one hand. The head turns left toward a small bright orange-red bird perched in the painted space just outside the opening. The child's eyes are huge and pale, the face softly shaded and melancholy, while the hood and sleeves carry scratchy dark lines over layered warm paint. Behind the bird, a muted gray city of stacked narrow buildings rises in sketchy vertical strokes. The mural is painted on a weathered exterior wall whose stains, seams, and worn plaster show through the scene. A darker architectural recess around the child creates the illusion of a real window, and a horizontal ledge runs across the lower part of the panel. The actual pavement or floor appears at the bottom as broad gray-brown planks or slabs. Light is diffuse daylight, keeping the rough masonry and painted figure equally readable. The limited palette of charcoal, tan, ocher, muted blue-gray, and rust red makes the bird and hood the strongest color notes. Fine pencil-like marks and broader brushy areas coexist, so the small story feels both carefully drawn and visibly handmade. The figure is compact within the dark frame, and the bird hangs just beyond reach. The photograph preserves the relationship between painted illusion and real wall, giving the quiet moment an urban, slightly wistful presence.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形街头艺术照片记录一名小孩坐在深窗台上的大型壁画。孩子穿尖尖的锈红帽兜和同色贴身衣服，双膝蜷起，一只手托着下巴。头向左转，望着画中开口外一只鲜亮橙红小鸟。孩子眼睛极大而浅亮，面孔柔和阴影中带忧伤，帽兜和衣袖有覆盖暖色层漆的干涩深线。鸟身后，低饱和灰色城市的层层狭楼以草图般竖线升起。壁画画在风化外墙上，污迹、接缝和磨损灰泥透过场景可见。孩子周围较深的建筑凹处制造真实窗子的幻觉，一道横向窗台贯穿画面下部。真实人行道或地板在底部作为宽阔灰棕木板或石板出现。光是漫射日光，让粗糙墙体和彩绘人物同样清楚。炭色、棕褐、赭黄、低饱和蓝灰和锈红的有限调色，让鸟和帽兜成为最强颜色。细铅笔般笔痕与较宽的刷色区域共存，使小故事既认真画出，又明显手工。人物紧凑地留在暗框里，小鸟停在触不到的外侧。照片保留彩绘幻觉与真实墙面的关系，让安静时刻带有城市中略忧伤的存在感。
style_prompt_en: Street-art photography shows a painted illusion within its actual weathered wall and pavement. Combine fine scratchy drawing, soft face modeling, and broader brushed color, letting masonry stains and seams remain visible. A compact focal form can sit inside a dark recess while a small vivid accent floats beyond it. Rust red, ocher, tan, muted blue-gray, and charcoal create an aged, wistful palette. Diffuse daylight reveals both pigment and substrate without theatrical shadow. Keep the framing wide enough to show how the artwork meets the real urban surface.
style_prompt_zh: 街头艺术摄影把彩绘幻觉与真实风化墙面和地面一起呈现。结合细干涩线描、柔和面部塑形与更宽的刷色，让砖墙污迹和接缝保持可见。紧凑焦点形体可位于暗凹处，一处小鲜亮重音悬在其外。锈红、赭黄、棕褐、低饱和蓝灰与炭色组成陈旧、微忧伤调色。漫射日光揭示颜料与承载面，没有戏剧阴影。取景足够宽，让作品与真实城市表面怎样相接清楚可见。
theme_en: A small red-hooded child sitting on a ledge beside a bright bird
theme_zh: 一名红帽小孩坐在窗台上，旁边有一只鲜亮小鸟
name: Herakut
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
